frames.title: Lift crate
frames.description: Front-right, lifting a framed wooden crate from ground with both hands and bent knees. Same bald stocky dwarf with brown beard, cream shirt and brown waistcoat.

frames.title: Carry sack
frames.description: Front-left, carrying a heavy sack over one shoulder while steadying it with both hands.

frames.title: Push stone barrow
frames.description: Right-side, pushing a wooden wheelbarrow loaded with small stones, complete wheel and handles.

frames.title: Pull supply sled
frames.description: Rear-right, pulling a rope tied around a short timber sled holding a crate, whole rope and sled within cell.

frames.title: Build crate
frames.description: Front-right, behind a low wooden bench driving nails into a framed crate with small hammer while other hand steadies board.

frames.title: Sweep wood chips
frames.description: Front-left, kneeling and sweeping wood chips into a pile with a short stiff broom near a small toolbox.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
